cells.note: Help page describes searching for and applying to jobs on LinkedIn.
Members create job alerts for a search, delivered daily or weekly by email or app notification, up to 20 alerts.
Skills Match insight shows how many of a job's required skills match the member's profile; no single verdict with a reason, and the page says it is rolling out.
Premium 'How you match' lists skills the job asks for that are missing from the member's profile.
Job listings show an employer-provided or estimated salary range; the page does not describe comparing an offered range with market pay.
Job details page shows a Meet the Hiring Team section where members can connect and message the poster and team, and members are notified when a first- or second-degree connection is hiring.
Members can save jobs (up to 2000) and view jobs they applied for on LinkedIn; the pages do not describe a status per job.
Members can report a job as spam or a scam and the page lists warning signs; the page does not describe an automatic check.
Open to Work can be limited to people using LinkedIn Recruiter; the page says complete privacy cannot be guaranteed.
Regular Workforce Reports on hiring, skills and migration trends in the US; not limited to white-collar occupations.
Workforce Reports include a city section covering trends in 20 of the largest US metro areas.
